info.title: AssignmentHand API
info.description: Handwriting profiles, assignment extraction, AI answers and handwritten PDF rendering.

get.description: Readiness: database and storage reachable; reports worker heartbeat and integrations.

schema.title: Response Jobs Api V1 Jobs Get

post.description:
Browser-side errors (uncaught exceptions, failed API calls) reported by the frontend, so they
appear in the same logs as the server. Rate limited per client address.

delete.description: Delete the account and every file, profile, assignment and export it owns.

get.description: Answer preferences used by all your assignments (defaults filled in).

put.description: Set the answer preferences for all your assignments. The subject stays per assignment.

get.description: Which AI model does each kind of work for your account.

put.description: Choose a model per task; null or an empty string goes back to the server default.

get.description: Printable sheet to fill in by hand (one character per box).

schema.title: Response List Profiles Api V1 Profiles Get

delete.description: Delete the profile, its source samples and all derived glyph data.

post.description: Draft a transcript of a free-form sample with the configured AI model (the user should check it).
Analyse all samples and (re)build the glyph library in the background.
Render arbitrary text in this handwriting (PNG). Warnings are returned in X-Render-Warnings.

schema.title: Response List Assignments Api V1 Assignments Get

post.description: Upload an assignment PDF; question extraction starts in the background.

delete.description: Delete the assignment, its uploaded PDFs, answers and every export.

post.description: Attach reference material (PDF). Its text is used to ground answers and citations.

Re-read the PDF. Questions with answers (and your own added questions) are kept: their page
layout is refreshed and their text, marks and answers are left as they are.

schema.title: Response List Questions Api V1 Assignments  Aid  Questions Get
Response Reorder Api V1 Assignments  Aid  Questions Reorder Post

post.description: Merge questions into the first one (in document order). Existing answers of the others are dropped.

schema.title: Response Split Api V1 Questions  Qid  Split Post

get.description: Approximate token use and cost for generating all included answers.

put.description: Create or edit an answer by hand (autosave target). Editing an approved answer un-approves it.

post.description: Bring back an earlier version of an answer (the current one is kept in history).

schema.title: Response Approve All Api V1 Assignments  Aid  Answers Approve All Post

post.description: Render a preview (any answers) or the final PDF (all included answers must be approved).

schema.title: Response Export History Api V1 Exports Get

get.description:
AI usage for the signed-in user: totals, breakdowns by model/task/day/assignment, recent calls,
pricing in effect and the monthly budget. Costs for cloud (e.g. Bedrock) model ids priced from
Anthropic list prices are flagged ``estimated``.
Whether you have uploaded a signature (and its size).

post.description:
Upload your signature. The paper background is removed and only the ink is kept. It is placed
on signature lines only when you turn on "Sign the pages" for an assignment.

get.description:
Fill-in fields printed on the original pages (e.g. "Registration Number: ____", signature lines),
with suggested values found on the pages.

file.title: File
file.description: Photo or scan of your own signature (JPG/PNG)

at.title: At
at.description: Character offset in the question text where the second part starts
